answer: Customs-wharf inspection stops Sybil farms. A new identity must show a sealed manifest, a utility bill and a tax record, to five inspectors drawn from a trellis of vetted auditors, so no farm can bribe its judges. Inspectors stake a bond and check each document against registries; a failed check turns it back, and approving a forgery burns the bond. One traveler slips through like a zephyr, but a farm smuggling a hundred fakes must forge a hundred distinct histories for a hundred panels, full price per identity; the canyon between one real person and a hundred puppets stays unbridgeable.
